description: This file implements multiplayer networking and lobby management for the Wesnoth game, including connection handling, lobby UI loop, and game start procedures.

classes.name: network_game_manager
classes.description: Manages network game lifecycle, ensuring leave_game message is sent on destruction.

methods.name: run_lobby_loop
methods.description: Runs the main lobby UI loop, handling events and network processing.

methods.name: open_connection
methods.description: Handles connecting to a server, including redirects, version checks, and login.

methods.name: enter_wait_mode
methods.description: Sets up and runs the wait lobby for joining or observing a game.

methods.name: enter_connect_mode
methods.description: Sets up and runs the connect lobby for hosting or joining a game.

methods.name: enter_create_mode
methods.description: Sets up and runs the create game lobby.

methods.name: enter_lobby_mode
methods.description: Main lobby loop allowing to join, observe, create, or quit.
